items.title_zh: Masteriyo LMS 反序列化 RCE
items.summary_zh: WordPress 外掛 Masteriyo LMS 存在反序列化漏洞，可導致遠端程式碼執行。
items.fix_hint: 更新至 3.4.1 或更高版本。
items.desc_en: The Masteriyo LMS  WordPress plugin before 3.4.1 does not prevent user-supplied values held as metadata from being deserialized when they are read back, allowing users with a minimal account to inject arbitrary PHP objects and, by way of a class shipped in a library bundled with the Masteriyo LMS  WordPress plugin before 3.4.1, write and execute arbitrary code on the server. A weaker form of the same issue is reachable without an account and yields an arbitrary file write rather than code execution.

items.summary_zh: The Events Calendar 外掛因驗證不足，未經授權即可執行遠端程式碼。
items.desc_en: The The Events Calendar plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution in all versions up to, and including, 6.17.4 via the is_safe_widget_instance function. This is due to insufficient protection in is_safe_widget_instance, which can be bypassed because PHP fires magic methods during its pre-parse, combined with enable_rendering_widget_copied() forging a valid wp_hash integrity attribute before unserialize() is reached. items.summary_zh: The Events Calendar 外掛 parse_array 函式驗證不足，導致遠端程式碼執行。
items.desc_en: The The Events Calendar plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution in all versions up to, and including, 6.17.3 via the parse_array function. This is due to insufficient validation of the widget 'classes' map, allowing a plain-array payload to bypass the is_safe_widget_instance() object check and reach the callable-invocation sink in Element_Classes::parse_array(). items.title_zh: DS Ad Rotator 任意檔案上傳 RCE
items.summary_zh: DS Ad Rotator 外掛缺乏權限與檔案類型檢查，導致未經授權上傳 PHP 檔案。
items.fix_hint: 建議移除或尋找替代方案，目前無修復更新。
items.desc_en: The DS Ad Rotator WordPress plugin through 0.8 does not perform any capability check, nonce verification, or file-type validation on its image upload handler, allowing unauthenticated attackers to upload arbitrary files, including PHP, to a web-accessible directory, which can lead to remote code execution.

items.title_zh: Frontegg SAML SSO 帳號接管
items.summary_zh: Frontegg SAML SSO 外掛未驗證 SAML 簽章，導致攻擊者可偽造身分登入。
items.fix_hint: 建議停用該外掛並檢查是否有更新。
items.desc_en: The Frontegg SAML SSO WordPress plugin through 1.0.1 does not verify the signature or issuer of SAML authentication responses before establishing a session, allowing unauthenticated attackers to log in as any user, including administrators, as well as to create arbitrary accounts.
